title: Surreal Media Ritual
description: A surreal night scene on a cracked concrete platform shows a couple in the foreground: a woman in a red patterned dress holding a smartphone and a man in a grey hoodie pushing a shopping cart filled with burning VHS tapes labeled 'MEMORY TRASH'. They stand amid film reels, roses, and flames while a silhouetted figure with a sword stands on a spotlighted stage over dark water. In the sky, a giant multi-eyed woman's face with blue smoke emerges from screens above a ruined building facade.
